# PVPResources

**Category:** Render  
**Aliases:** PVPResources

## What it does

Counts totems, experience bottles, end crystals, and enchanted golden apples in inventory.

Description basis: [source review](https://github.com/Pan4ur/ThunderHack-Recode/blob/49c76bcc5a5e4fbd12b06305c09f0c8fb76c510b/src/main/java/thunder/hack/features/hud/impl/PVPResources.java). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
